description: Turn on an instance's Native API, which iOS and Android apps need to use Clerk. Returns the Native API settings, with api_enabled. Register the app first with create_ios_application or create_android_application. Enabling it again changes nothing. To turn it off, use the Clerk Dashboard.

instance.description: Instance to target: "development", "production", or a full instance ID (ins_…).

name: enable_native_api
title: Enable the Native API
